A '''Slayer cape''' is the [[Cape of Accomplishment]] for players who have achieved level 99 in the [[Slayer]] skill. The cape can be purchased for 99,000 [[coins]] from [[Duradel]] (or [[Kuradal]] after completion of [[While Guthix Sleeps]]), in [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]]. Slayer capes are black in colour, and have a red trim if the player has more than one level 99 skill. As Duradel is in Shilo Village, players must have completed the [[Shilo Village]] [[quest]] in order to buy the cape.

Like all [[Capes of Achievement|skill capes]], the Slayer cape gives +9 to all defensive stats, and also a +4 bonus to prayer if it is trimmed, which requires a separate skill at level 99. The cape is automatically trimmed if this condition is met.

When the Slayer cape is equipped or in the inventory, there is a 10% chance of being given the option to have their previous [[Slayer task]] reassigned by the same [[Slayer Master]] the player got their last task from, either in person or through the [[Astral Contact]] spell.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1544268037964038144|date=5 July 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/105473|archivedate=14 May 2023|quote=You'd need to be on the same master as before, otherwise it can't trigger.}} If activated on a [[boss]] task, the assigned boss can potentially be a different one. 

When the cape effect activates on [[Konar quo Maten]]'s tasks, she will retain the same location as with the old task. On [[Mortimer]]'s tasks, the modifier of the task is retained.

Showing the cape to a master also bypasses [[combat level]] restrictions on tasks for lower-levelled accounts. When activated after skipping a task, they will offer the last task that was assigned, rather than the last one that was completed. If using [[Task Storage]], you can receive the same task you have stored, but the Slayer skillcape perk will '''not''' apply.

==Trivia==
* If the player blocks a Slayer task and the cape's perk procs when receiving a new task afterward, they will be assigned a random task, with an accompanying message in the game chat stating {{mes|You could not be reassigned your previous Slayer task because you have blocked that task.}}
* The Slayer cape and the [[Hitpoints cape]] are much harder to obtain untrimmed than other [[Cape of Accomplishment|capes of accomplishment]], as players are likely to get a 99 in one of the other combat skills first. A few options for players who want to obtain this cape untrimmed include limiting [[Ranged]] experience to only be gained from a [[Dwarf multicannon|dwarf cannon]] while on tasks and in general as much as possible. Players should always prioritise [[TzHaar Fight Cave|Fight Caves]] tasks as much as possible too for the 25,250 Experience drop [[TzTok-Jad]] gives. Any [[Experience lamp|Lamps]] gained through [[Random events]] and other activities should be put towards Slayer. Gaining Slayer experience through [[Temple Trekking#Rewards|Temple Trekking]] [[Slayer tome|Experience tomes]] can also help level Slayer ahead of other skills. In general, avoiding excess combat related experience while completing different tasks is essential, and balancing all combat training with other rewards can result in getting this cape untrimmed without going through too much trouble. Giving more focus towards avoiding barraging & bursting tasks and instead manually killing assigned monsters before any 99s are reached can also prove beneficial for intentionally avoiding combat experience in other skills prior to obtaining an untrimmed Slayer cape.<ref>See [[Cape of Accomplishment#Keeping Skillcapes untrimmed|Untrimmed Skillcapes]].</ref>
